subtitle: Lesson 32 · Monitoring & Cost Management for Training Clusters

eyebrow: Nothing crashes, so nothing obviously fires

steps.label: Crashed
steps.sub: status flips to Failed — a clear, discrete signal

steps.label: Stalled
steps.sub: still Running; progress has quietly stopped

eyebrow: Two signals, watched as a trend
code:
# GPU utilization near-zero for a "Running" job
avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{namespace="training-lm"}) by (job_name) < 5

# Loss hasn't moved in 30 minutes
changes(solara_training_loss{namespace="training-lm"}[30m]) == 0
caption: Neither signal alone is perfect — that's why the Alertmanager rule requires it to hold for a sustained window, not an instant.

eyebrow: Routed by the same namespace split
code:
- alert: TrainingJobStalled
  expr: avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{namespace=~"training-lm|training-mm"})
        by (namespace, job_name) < 5
  for: 15m
  labels: {severity: critical}

route:
  routes:
    - match: {namespace: training-lm}
      receiver: lm-team-slack
    - match: {namespace: training-mm}
      receiver: mm-team-slack
caption: The same training-lm / training-mm labels that drove monitoring and cost now route the alert to the right team.
